title: PeriodicTasks.update_changed() causes lock timeout with high concurrency
author: rodrigondec
body_preview: **Problem:**  The `PeriodicTasks.update_changed()` method uses `update_or_create()` which internally calls `select_for_update()`. This causes an exclusive lock on the single row (ident=1) in the `django_celery_beat_periodictasks` table.
